key_insight: Medi-Gemma combines deterministic EMR analytics with retrieval-augmented generation to reduce hallucinations and keep clinical responses grounded in validated patient data.
clinical_relevance: This could support safer wound-triage decision support by making reasoning more traceable, data-aware, and aligned with evidence-based pathways.
method: ClinicalOrchestrator coordinates data handling, query routing, and response generation.
DataManager cleans EMR files and uses PandasQueryEngine for deterministic structured-data queries.
ClinicalRAGEngine plus a Ground Truth Injection Module injects the latest validated patient snapshot into prompts; ProtocolManager and SafetyVerifier enforce safety rules.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports validation results showing reduced semantic context drift, fewer database-related crashes, and improved factual adherence to clinical repositories.
watch_item: Implementation quality depends on accurate token extraction, clean structured EMR data, and robust rule maintenance, so errors in preprocessing or routing could still affect reliability.
paper_title: Medi-Gemma: A Hybrid Clinical Decision Support System Integrating Deterministic EMR Analytics and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
